scope: Independent read-only Android local image-overlay milestone audit
limitations: Controlled DOM, storage, timers and file picker harness; actual production JavaScript executed with native Skia raster/PNG/JPEG/WebP codecs.
Chromium could not launch: socket restriction, then approved-mode environment setup failure; no Chromium, Android WebView, device, performance or APK verification counted.
Core renderer intentionally uses encoded-sRGB premultiplied filtering and fixed4x4 edge coverage; not linear-light, analytic coverage or cross-backend bit-equivalence.

fixed_findings.issue: Blur-cancelled import left pick/file controls disabled
fixed_findings.regression: pending import canceled by blur resets controls, ignores late completion and allows another import

fixed_findings.issue: JPEG parser accepted half-truncated stream without EOI
fixed_findings.regression: patched JPEG parser rejects every byte-truncation near EOI, half-stream cut and trailing bytes before decode
